profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Argonne National Laboratory | M.S. Software Engineering @ Purdue (ML & Data) | B.S. CS Alum @ UC Santa Cruz
profile.summary:
Hello, I’m a Software Engineer at Argonne National Laboratory, where I develop software solutions that assist beamline scientists and users in conducting and analyzing their experiments at the Advanced Photon Source in the Scientific Software Engineering and Data Management Group, X-ray Science Division.

I am currently pursuing a Master of Science in Software Engineering at Purdue University, with a Concentration in Machine Learning and Data Science and coursework through the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, as a part-time online student. I earned a B.S. in Computer Science from UC Santa Cruz, graduating Summa Cum Laude (Top 2% of School of Engineering by GPA) with Highest Honors in Computer Science.

Previously, I worked as an R&D Software and DevOps Intern at Keysight Technologies and as an AI Fellow at JP Morgan Chase.

I’m passionate about software engineering, AI and machine learning, data management, and data analysis, with a particular interest in developing tools and applications that help users solve complex problems.

projects.title: AI-Driven Stock Predictions
projects.description:
Objectives:
• Working with JPMorganChase on an AI-Driven Financial News Analysis Project through Break Through Tech's AI Studio program.
• Developing an AI agent to analyze financial news and predict its impact on stock prices.
• The project aims to enhance the accuracy of stock predictions and improve financial outcomes for clients.

Methodologies:
• Utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP), unsupervised learning, and various models (including neural networks, SVM, ARIMA model, transformers, and linear regression)
 for sentiment analysis and predictive modeling.
• The agent will summarize news and provide recommendations based on the news' likelihood to increase or decrease stock values.

projects.title: Course Scheduling Planner using Deep Learning
projects.description:
Objective:
• Develop an intelligent course scheduling system for personalized academic planning. 
 
Key Features:  
(1) Leverages data from RateMyProfessor reviews, course prerequisites, and major requirements.  
(2) Utilizes deep learning and sentiment analysis to evaluate instructor feedback and course reviews (specifically, fine-tuning a transformer and using prompt engineering).
(3) Identifies patterns that correlate with academic success and student satisfaction.  
(4) Optimizes course selections to recommend tailored quarterly schedules.  

Benefits:  
(1) Balances academic progress with individual preferences and requirements.  
(2) Empowers students to make informed scheduling decisions.  
(3) Enhances overall educational experiences with personalized recommendations.
